rows.note: Use 仙 as the all-purpose spoken term for an ordinary currency cent when the currency is clear.

example.english: This drink is only one cent cheaper.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 je5 ping4 zo2 jat1 sin1 zaa3

rows.note: Use 分 for a cent as a numerical money unit, and for each small unit of money in phrases meaning every last cent.

example.english: I won't pay a cent more.
example.jyutping: ngo5 lin4 jat1 fan1 dou1 m4 wui5 bei2 do1

rows.note: Use 少少錢 when cent means a small sum of money rather than the currency unit itself.

example.english: I only have a little money, so I can't spare a cent.
example.traditional: 我手頭得少少錢，連一仙都唔可以亂使。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau2 tau4 dak1 siu2 siu2 cin2 lin4 jat1 sin1 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 sai2

rows.note: Use 歐仙 specifically for a euro cent, to distinguish it from an ordinary cent.

example.english: This item costs one euro cent more.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 fo3 gwai3 jat1 au1 sin1
